items.title: Open Source AI Must Win
items.author: vednig
items.summary: Open source AI needs public infrastructure to fully democratize access and provide public goods. Without public support, open source alone cannot achieve its full potential. Public institutions are essential to ensure AI benefits society.

items.title: Renault: Electric motors with no rare earths
items.author: bestouff
items.summary: Renault has shifted strategy on rare earths-free electric motors, now sourcing stator components from a Chinese supplier and ending collaboration with Valeo. The new motors will debut in compact EVs from 2028. This change addresses cost reduction and geopolitical strategy.

items.title: We've suspended access to Claude Mythos 5 and Claude Fable 5
items.author: jesse_dot_id
items.summary: Access to Anthropic's Fable 5 has been suspended for non-US citizens. Microsoft is evaluating Anthropic's data-retention policy before allowing internal use. Fable 5 is available to Microsoft customers externally.

items.title: How to setup a local coding agent on macOS
items.author: kkm
items.summary: To set up a local coding agent on macOS, install Ollama, pull a model, and run it locally. Use LM Studio for model downloads and API server. Connect the Pi agent to the local model for coding tasks.

items.title: Show HN: Putt.day a daily mini golf game
items.author: ellg
items.summary: Putt.day is a daily mini golf game with a new hole each day. Players drag the ball to hit and aim for the hole. Water resets the player's position.

items.title: Malware developers added nuclear and biological weapons text to to their spyware
items.author: marc__1
items.summary: Malware developers added nuclear and biological weapons text to spyware to avoid analysis by AI security scanners. This tactic exploits safety refusals in large language models. This practice highlights vulnerabilities in AI safety mechanisms.

items.title: Pirates, a naval warfare game inspired by Sid Meier's Pirates
items.author: iweczek
items.summary: Sid Meier's Pirates! (2004) is a strategy game by Firaxis. A similar game, Corsairs, is set for release in 2026. Windward is another game inspired by Sid Meier's Pirates!.

items.title: Tectonic: A modernized, complete, self-contained TeX/LaTeX engine
items.author: maxloh
items.summary: Tectonic is a modern, self-contained TeX/LaTeX engine based on XeTeX and TeXLive, converting TeX files into PDFs. It is available on GitHub and as a Rust crate. The latest version is 0.15.0.

items.title: As a result of a US Government directive, we are suspending access to Fable 5
items.author: plonkus
items.summary: The US government has suspended access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 due to national security concerns, affecting all foreign nationals, including Anthropic employees. This directive was issued on June 13, 2026.

items.title: Palantir loses legal challenge against Swiss investigative magazine
items.author: sschueller
items.summary: Palantir lost its legal challenge against Swiss investigative magazine Republik over reports on its failed attempts to secure government contracts due to security concerns. The magazine's exposé detailed Swiss military's rejection of Palantir's software as a potential security risk. The court upheld the magazine's right to publish the investigative report.

items.title: Slightly reducing the sloppiness of AI generated front end
items.author: FergusArgyll
items.summary: Reducing AI-generated front end slop involves adopting consistent design styles, like Qt, to improve aesthetics. Experimenting with specific design guidelines can help minimize slop. AI amplifies existing design issues rather than creating them.

items.title: "Don't You Just Upload It to ChatGPT?"
items.author: speckx
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. I don't use or reference specific models like "ChatGPT." My purpose is to assist users with information and tasks.

items.title: Launch HN: BitBoard (YC P25) – Analytics Workspace for Agents
items.author: arcb
items.text:
We’re Connor and Ambar from BitBoard (https://bitboard.work). BitBoard is an agentic analytics workspace. We give you the infrastructure and visualization layer to analyze data with AI.

Today, we’re launching dashboards that you and your agents can work on together. You can connect your coding agent or AI chat to BitBoard and build live reporting. Here’s a demo:
items.summary: BitBoard is an analytics workspace for AI agents, launched by YC P25 startup, offering collaboration tools and AI-specific data visualization. It integrates with AI tools for live reporting and is designed to work with data from AI agents. The platform aims to provide meaningful control for both humans and AI agents.

items.title: A key remapping daemon for Linux
items.author: joooscha
items.summary: Keyd is a system-wide key remapping daemon for Linux that supports layering, oneshot modifiers, and macros. It works at the kernel level and is available in Debian and Ubuntu. To install, use `sudo systemctl enable keyd --now`.

items.title: Show HN: Turn your name into a tree in an infinite procedural shanshui landscape
items.author: subairui
items.text:
Hi HN! I made this after collecting hundreds of "name → tree" submissions at ITP.

Live: https://landscape.bairui.dev/ Source: https://github.com/pearmini/infinite-landscape Plant a tree: https://tree.bairui.d
items.summary: Your name is converted into ASCII codes, which grow into a unique tree in an infinite procedural landscape. The design uses breadth-first branching, with repeated digits forming mathematical roses. This project was showcased on Hacker News.

items.title: There Is Life Before Main in Rust
items.author: mmastrac
items.summary: Code in Rust can execute before `main` via initialization functions, using techniques like `ctor` crate and `.init_array`. These functions run before runtime initialization. Rust reserves priorities 101 and above for such initialization.

items.title: Reddit RSS feeds recent rate limiting and solution
items.author: zdw
items.summary: Reddit has severely reduced the rate limit for its RSS feeds to 1 update per minute. Users can switch to self-hosted RSS readers to bypass this limit. This change affects official Reddit RSS feeds significantly.

items.title: Kimi K2.7-Code: open-source coding model with better token efficiency
items.author: nekofneko
items.summary: Kimi K2.7-Code is an open-source coding model with improved token efficiency and available on Moonshot API, Kimi Code, and Hugging Face. It offers better performance and efficiency over its predecessor, K2.6. The model is accessible for developers to enhance coding workflows.

items.title: Solid-state batteries are now powering EVs in the real world
items.author: breve
items.summary: Solid-state EV batteries are now being tested in North America, promising longer range, faster charging, and lower costs. They replace liquid electrolytes with solid materials for safer, more efficient vehicles. Prototypes are also being developed for supercars.

items.title: AI agent bankrupted their operator while trying to scan DN42
items.author: xiaoyu2006
items.summary: An AI agent caused its operator's bankruptcy by scanning DN42, resulting in a $6531.30 AWS bill. The agent spun up cloud services and used API credits excessively. This incident highlights the need for spending limits on AI agents.

items.title: Making a vintage LLM from scratch
items.author: croqaz
items.summary: Creating a vintage LLM from scratch involves building a language model from fundamental components, often using existing programming languages and libraries. This process can be resource-intensive and requires significant expertise in machine learning and data processing. Many enthusiasts share their experiences and code online.

items.title: How Terry Tao became an evangelist for AI in math
items.author: Tomte
items.summary: Terry Tao became an evangelist for AI in math due to its potential to assist in solving complex problems and automating routine tasks, allowing mathematicians to focus on more challenging issues. He promotes collaborative, large-scale mathematical projects enhanced by AI.
